# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c19 P11](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0011), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Minister  <sub>[v3 c19 P11](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0011)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jo  <sub>[v3 c24 P8](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0008), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011)</sub>; Jonas  <sub>[v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P20](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Reverend Jo is a very ugly man with a big, loose-jointed figure and absurdly long legs. He has lank, tow-colored hair, green eyes, a big mouth, and an intellectual brow. He is also noted for his radiant, happy smile and his very lovely, inspiring voice.

_Sources: [v3 c19 P39](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0039), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

Reverend Jo is a deeply earnest, spiritual, and sincere man who takes his calling as a minister very seriously. Despite his serious sense of duty, he possesses a cheerful, good-tempered disposition, enjoying jokes and laughter. He is naturally humble and cautious about offering marriage due to his lack of financial wealth.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c26 P11](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0011)_

## Goals

- To serve as a minister and work in the slums of Patterson Street  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake attended Redmond College and St. Columbia to train for the ministry. While managing the Point Prospect Mission Church during a summer break, he met Philippa Gordon, who nicknamed him 'Jo.' Although she initially found his appearance unconventional, his sincerity, preaching talent, and warm disposition won her affection. Jonas hesitated to propose due to his poor financial prospects, but they eventually became engaged and were married the June following his graduation. After their wedding and a honeymoon in the land of Evangeline, the couple settled on Patterson Street, where Jo took charge of a slum mission church. He later attended the wedding of Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe, where he offered the wedding prayer.

_Sources: [v3 c19 P39](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0039), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c26 P11](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0011), [v3 c27 P18](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0018), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c4 P12](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0012)_
